emails.subject: Re: Kaya Butter Toast Review - Tomorrow 8:30am Live Re-Taste
emails.text:
Hey Daniel & Wei Ling,

My reel from yesterday ('Did Nanyang Kopi shrink their butter slice?!') just crossed 90,000 views. I love your coffee, so I'm happy to come down tomorrow morning at 8:30am to film a live re-taste and show your kitchen's side.

My usual rate is SGD 600, or I can do SGD 450 if you throw in 20 of your Kaya Toast plushie keychains for my comment-section giveaway. One condition: whatever butter cut and toast prep you serve me on camera has to be the exact same standard every regular customer gets, because my followers will check.

Cheers,
Zack (@MakanWithZack)

emails.subject: Internal counter hygiene SOP - cash handling vs ready-to-eat toast
emails.text:
Hi Wei Ling and Arjun,

After this week's morning observation, a reminder of our internal counter hygiene SOP. Money handling and ready-to-eat food prep must stay separate at the toast station: any staff member who handles coins or notes has to remove gloves and wash hands before slicing kaya butter toast or cracking soft-boiled eggs (+40s per order).

At the 8am rush both toast staff are on the line, so there is no spare pair of hands to take cash and make change without slowing toast orders. Please keep the SOP in mind when we discuss the cash-paying regulars.

Thanks,
Hafiz
Outlet Hygiene & Safety Lead
